library(kableExtra)
 options(knitr.table.format = 'markdown')
library(dplyr)

personalized_info <- read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/CIS_MarkDownText.csv"))

dds <- NULL
if (file.exists(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall1.csv"))) {
  da1 <-read.csv(paste0(params$temp_dir, "/datall1.csv"), stringsAsFactors = FALSE)
  costt <- formatC(da1$total_cost1, format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  #costt <- formatC(signif(da1$total_cost1, digits=3), format="f", big.mark=",", digits=0)
  da1$unit <- gsub(" bag", "", da1$unit1)
  da1$kgs1 <- round(da1$kgs1, digits=0)
  da1title1 <-  paste(da1$fertilizer1, ": kilo ", da1$kgs1, " kwa ekari", " ", da1$field_area, " ",  " (~", " mifuko ", " ", da1$bags1, " ", "ya kilo",  " ", da1$unit, ")"," = ",
                      costt, " ", da1$currency, sep="")
  da1bag <- da1[,c("rep")]
  
  dds <- data.frame(type = as.character(da1$fertilizer1), cost=round(da1$costPerBag1, digits = 0),
                    units = as.character(da1$unit1), currency=as.character(da1$currency))
  dds$units <- ifelse(dds$units == "50kg bag", "mfuko wa kilo hamsini", as.character(dds$units))
}else{
  da1 <- NULL
}

data <- subset(geodata[1,], select = c("name", "latitude", "longitude"))

minLong=data$longitude - 0.05
maxLong=data$longitude + 0.05
minLat=data$latitude - 0.05
maxLat=data$latitude + 0.05
library(leaflet)
library(mapview)
my_map <- data %>%
  
  #leaflet(width = "10%") %>%
  #leaflet(options= leafletOptions(minZoom = 3, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  leaflet(options= leafletOptions(minZoom = 8, maxZoom = 10)) %>%
  addProviderTiles(providers$Esri.NatGeoWorldMap)%>%
  #setView(lng = -95.7129, lat = 37.0902, zoom = 4) %>%
  
  # addMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude
  #          )%>% 
  #addRectangles(lat1 = minLat, lng1 = minLong, lat2 = maxLat, lng2 = maxLong)%>% 
  addCircleMarkers(~longitude, ~latitude, color="white", fillColor = "transparent", weight = 10, radius = 30)%>% 
  
  addScaleBar()
#addTiles()
mm <- "my_map.png"
if (file.exists(mm)) file.remove(mm)

mapshot(my_map,  height=100, file="map.png")

# calculating tuberUP based on sweetPotatoUP, sweetPotatoUW and conversion factor for sweetPotato product sold
    tuberConv <- data.frame(sweetPotatoPD = c("tubers", "flour"),
    conversion = c(1, 3.2))
    if (is.na(sweetPotatoUP) &
        sweetPotatoPD == "tubers" &
        country == "TZ") {sweetPotatoUP = 120000; sweetPotatoUW = 1000}
    if (is.na(sweetPotatoUP) &
        sweetPotatoPD == "flour" &
        country == "TZ") {sweetPotatoUP = 384000; sweetPotatoUW = 1000}

    tuberUP <- sweetPotatoUP /
        sweetPotatoUW /
        tuberConv[tuberConv$sweetPotatoPD == sweetPotatoPD,]$conversion * 1000
    #
